data.name: Call Forth the Spawn
data.description: 3/day, you may use destruction as a spell-like ability. The body of a creature slain by this ability immediately transforms into an ochre jelly under your mental control. Ochre jellies created by this ability melt away into noxious residue after 1 hr. This ability is the equivalent of a 9th-level spell.
